figures.name: Shakyamuni Buddha

ability.name: Diamond Sutra
ability.description: Neutralize all enemy illusion and ego-based abilities; grant +3 wisdom to all allies.

figures.description: The historical Buddha whose awakening under the Bodhi tree established the dharma that liberated millions.

figures.name: Mara

ability.name: Army of Desires
ability.description: Summon four desire-demon allies with 5/5/5/5/5 stats; inflict delusion on all enemies.

figures.description: The Buddhist lord of death and desire who tempted the Buddha with his armies of delusion and daughters.

figures.name: Avalokiteshvara

ability.name: Universal Compassion
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to all allies; remove all suffering effects from the field.

figures.description: The bodhisattva of infinite compassion who hears all cries of suffering in the universe.

figures.name: Manjushri

ability.name: Wisdom Sword
ability.description: Cut through all enemy illusion: reveal all hidden cards; deal 5 damage to ego-based enemies.

figures.description: Bodhisattva of wisdom whose flaming sword cuts through ignorance and whose discourse reveals ultimate truth.

figures.name: Vajrapani

ability.name: Vajra Thunderbolt
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to one enemy; shatter all their armor and defense abilities.

figures.description: The thunderbolt-wielding bodhisattva who is the most powerful protector and destroyer of obstacles.

figures.name: Tara

ability.name: Swift Savior
ability.description: React to any ally being attacked: grant that ally +4 defense instantly.

figures.description: The female bodhisattva of swift liberation who crosses the ocean of samsara and saves all who call her name.

figures.name: Nagarjuna

ability.name: Emptiness Teaching
ability.description: All enemy power-based abilities lose their basis; reduce all enemy power by 3.

figures.description: The greatest Buddhist philosopher who received teachings from Nagas in the underworld and founded Madhyamaka.

figures.name: Milarepa

ability.name: Mystic Heat
ability.description: This card generates warmth: all allies gain +2 defense against cold and dark attacks.

figures.description: The great Indian-Tibetan yogi who attained enlightenment in one lifetime through intense cave meditation.

figures.name: Naga King

ability.name: Rain Serpent
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; call rain to extinguish all fire effects on the field.

figures.description: The divine serpent kings who protect the dharma, bring rain and guard treasures in underground palaces.

figures.name: Jataka Hero

ability.name: Selfless Gift
ability.description: Sacrifice 3 HP to grant all allies +2 to all stats from infinite compassion.

figures.description: The heroes of the Jataka Tales — the Buddha in his previous lives giving all for the benefit of others.

figures.name: Yaksha

ability.name: Yaksha's Challenge
ability.description: Ask one enemy a riddle: if they fail (wisdom below 7) they lose their next turn.

figures.description: Powerful nature spirits who guard treasures and ask riddles; dangerous when disrespected, helpful when honored.

figures.name: Hariti

ability.name: Mother's Reform
ability.description: Convert one dark enemy to neutral alignment for 2 turns through the power of maternal love.

figures.description: The former child-devouring demoness converted by the Buddha who became the protective goddess of children.

figures.name: Mahakashyapa

ability.name: Silent Smile
ability.description: Grant one ally wordless wisdom: +3 wisdom that cannot be countered or reduced.

figures.description: The chief disciple who received the Buddha's silent flower transmission — the origin of Zen meditation.

figures.name: Kubera

ability.name: Wealth Guardian
ability.description: Steal 3 HP from the richest enemy and grant it to the poorest ally.

figures.description: The Buddhist god of wealth and guardian of the northern direction who commands the yaksha host.

figures.name: Vimalakirti

ability.name: Thunderous Silence
ability.description: Answer the question of non-duality: all field dualities (light/dark, buff/debuff) collapse to zero.

figures.description: The enlightened layman who defeated all bodhisattvas in debate through his thunderous silence.

figures.name: Preta

ability.name: Hungry Haunting
ability.description: Drain 1 HP from one ally per turn from insatiable need.

figures.description: The hungry ghosts of Buddhist cosmology whose enormous bellies and tiny necks prevent them from ever being satisfied.

figures.name: Dharma Protector

ability.name: Protector's Wrath
ability.description: Prevent all disruption of Buddhist practice abilities; deal 4 damage to chaos enemies.

figures.description: The fierce wrathful dharmapalas (dharma protectors) who guard Buddhist teachings with terrifying power.

figures.name: Upagupta

ability.name: Convert Enemy
ability.description: Reduce one dark enemy's power by 3 and their alignment shifts toward neutral.

figures.description: The monk who converted even Mara himself by sitting in meditation upon a throne of corpses.

figures.name: Asura King

ability.name: Jealous War
ability.description: Force two enemies to attack each other instead of your allies for 1 turn.

figures.description: The proud asura kings who constantly war with the gods out of jealousy, trapped in their own suffering.

figures.name: Bodhidharma

ability.name: Wall Gazing
ability.description: This card cannot be moved or targeted while meditating; after 2 turns, gain +4 to all stats.

figures.description: The Indian monk who brought Chan Buddhism to China and meditated facing a wall for nine years.
